verdict.rationale: Omnara documents event webhooks that deliver JSON POST requests with `event` and `data`, and agents can pause to ask questions when they need input, so the product has its own outbound notification mechanism tied to agent activity. The evidence does not show which events are emitted, so notification on task completion or on needing input is only implied. missing for 10: documented event types for task completion and input-required/approval-pending, push/mobile or email notification delivery, independent or hands-on corroboration of notifications.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get notified when an agent completes a task or needs my input

citations.quote: Configure an event webhook to receive JSON POST requests with `event` and `data`.
agents can pause to ask questions when they need your input
